text: Settle into a comfortable position.
Let your body arrive in its own way.
without needing to adjust anything.
Allow your breath to move in a slow, natural rhythm, each breath creating more openness
through your whole body. As your breath steadies, you may begin to sense a warm light within your
Arm body, steady, gentle, naturally present.
This light represents abundance.
Let your inhale make this light more noticeable, let your exhale help your body rest into it.
Feel the space across your chest widen.
Feel your stomach soften.
Feel the muscles along your shoulders and back settling into ease.
This light spreads through you, through your arms, your torso, your legs, a calm, steady
presence, filling your entire body.
Abundance begins as a feeling, a quiet readiness within you, a soft clarity, an inner openness
that grows gently.
With each breath, allow this light to expand through your whole system.
Let it fill the space around you, creating a warm, spacious field that your body can
rest inside.
With each inhale, you gather clarity and openness.
With each exhale, your whole being aligns a little more.
With the steady support of this moment, you don't have to reach for abundance.
You are allowing it to rise from within you - calm, grounded, naturally present.
Feel your body soften even more fully into this warm and steady light.
Feel this energy settling through your chest, your stomach, your spine, your legs, a complete
sense of inner spaciousness.
Take a slow breath in, let the exhale spread this warmth through your entire body, creating
a clear, open sense of possibility within you.
You are steady.
You are open.
You are fully aligned with abundance from the inside out, calm, grounded, and quietly
supported.
Carry this warmth with you into the rest of your day.
